Status: wave 333: 1099 accessor names derived by --suggest-accessors, with whitelisted rows and any contract family holding a protected member excluded

Method.evidence: --suggest-accessors on the v332 map derived 1607 conventional accessor names from property and contract-family evidence. The updater refuses a name the SDK whitelist preserves and renames a contract family as a unit, so the batch excludes every whitelisted row (by file name, since modules can sit under CV/ folders) and every family that contains a protected member - 27 families, 60 rows. Two rows the updater refused for their own reason (an operator special name and a colliding accessor) were removed after the first run named them.
Method.themes: This is the first wave driven by the tool own derived evidence at scale: 1099 names across Falcon, ObjectModel, HawkNET, CvNext, ActiveTree, DynamicData, Sdk, CalculatedParameters, Common, InformationExtract and DevKit. Family-level protection is now explicit: one protected member blocks the whole family.
